timing_contract.resident: Current FP32 query already on device; encoding, query norms, search/selection/filter/global-ID mapping and optional direct FP32 refinement included. CUDA events include CPU launch gaps in uncaptured operation. Captured graphs repeat one complete operation.
timing_contract.host_service: Python wall interval: pageable FP32 query H2D, all uncaptured computation, synchronization and complete F32 distances/int64 global IDs D2H. Host allocation/dispatch included; database preparation/index training excluded and separately charged.
timing_contract.setup: Constructor wall interval includes static CPU compaction/padding, uploads, database encoding/norms, allocations and library/native tuning or index training. First run and capture are separately recorded.
timing_contract.memory: Named owned buffers and available library allocation accounting; resource reservations and shared-device free-memory observations are separate. No physical peak or exclusive-device claim.
